title: Algebraization of finite schemes over the thickenings of a scheme over a complete Noetherian ring
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal such that $A$ is $I$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]; put $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $S_n=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ for $n\ge0$. Let $X\to S$ be a separated morphism of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and $X_n=X\times_SS_n$ [def-pc-base-change], with the closed immersions $X_n\to X_{n+1}$. Suppose given schemes $Y_n$ with finite morphisms $f_n:Y_n\to X_n$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and morphisms $Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ making the squares with $X_n\to X_{n+1}$ commute and cartesian ($Y_n\cong Y_{n+1}\times_{X_{n+1}}X_n$ over $X_n$), and assume $Y_0\to S_0$ (the composite $Y_0\to X_0\to S_0$) is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Then there exist a finite morphism $f:Y\to X$ and isomorphisms $Y\times_XX_n\cong Y_n$ of $X_n$-schemes, compatible with the maps $Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$; moreover $Y$ is proper over $S$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 09ZT (label lemma-algebraize-formal-scheme-finite-over-proper; there indexed by S_n = Spec(A/I^n), n >= 1), with its proof via Grothendieck's existence theorem (Theorem 088C, Remark reformulate-existence-theorem) and Lemma finite-pushforward-coherent
